thread:
Aisha: Heads-up 1h before SableTech dedicated pool flip. Need final confirmation on quota, autoscale backstop, and who runs customer-facing soak. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sabletech-dedicated
Tom: I can run the soak call and dashboard. Quota we promised = 3x V100 equiv reserved, with burst to 5 for 15m. Confirm?
Ravi: 3 reserved + burst 5 OK. Suggest autoscale cooldown 2m, scale step = 1 node to avoid overshoot. Also add CPU/GPU temp alerts.
Lena: I'll own billing confirmation and renewal note. Renewal risk if error-rate > 1% during soak. We'll flag sales immediately.
Tom: For the load test I propose two passes: cold-cache short run then steady-state soak. Cold pass: 5m @30% traffic. Soak: 45m @100% with two 3m spikes at 140%.
Aisha: Add poisson arrival jitter and token-level metrics. Also pin model to r-infer-v2 to avoid drift.
Ravi: Load generator snippet (locust):
```
from locust import HttpUser, task
class SableUser(HttpUser):
  @task
def gen(self):
    self.client.post('/v1/generate', json={'prompt':'ping'}, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer secret'})
```
Tom: I'll upload the full script to /ci/loadtests/sabletech/commit: 9f8e7d and kick off from our test cluster.
ops-bot: scheduled: dedicated-pool-sabletech brings up at 04:00 UTC. Canary deploy in progress.
Aisha: Oncall coverage? Need eng-oncall + infra lead for first 60m after cutover. Tom, can you coordinate rota?
Tom: Yep. I'll put myself + Ravi for first hour, then Lena for billing/sales comms.
Lena: Confirmed billing contact: sara@sabletech.com. I'll send one-sentence approval request re: burst billing.
Ravi: Metrics to watch: p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx count, request queue depth, gpu_mem_free, hot-shard ratio, tokens/sec. Set alert: 5xx > 0.5% over 5m -> rollback.
Aisha: Also capture customer sentiment: 15m debrief with SableTech PM after soak. Tom, can you draft short survey and anomaly summary?
Tom: Will do. Short post-run checklist: 1) take heap snapshots if OOMs 2) save loadtest traces 3) tag run in infra logs.
Lena: If we hit errors >1% we'll pause billing and mark renewal as at-risk in the CRM. I'm looping in account exec.
Ravi: One more ops ask: don't touch model weights or quantization flags during the window.
Aisha: Agreed. Final go/no-go at T-2h. If anything blocks, we hold. Thanks all.
Tom: I'll post rota + call link in 30m. :thumbsup:

Aisha: Closing thread for now. Will ping at T-12h for preflight.
